name: 酷炫車子
look: A cool cartoon sports car with a face, sleek low body painted glossy electric blue with orange flame decals and a big rear spoiler, big friendly eyes in the windshield and a smiling front grille, chunky black wheels with silver rims, side view facing left
style: simple flat vector illustration style with thick dark outlines and soft cel shading, like a children's picture book sticker, plain solid white background, no shadow, no text

poses.idle: Full body side view visible, parked on the ground facing left with a confident cool smile
poses.happy: Full body side view visible, bouncing in the air on its wheels with a huge happy grin, eyes closed with joy, headlights glowing

dizzy.text: Full body side view visible, sitting crooked on the ground with swirly spiral eyes and its tongue out of the grille, one wheel wobbling off

poses.surprised: Full body side view visible, eyes huge and mouth grille wide open in shock, body jumped up slightly
poses.fast: Full body side view visible, racing to the left leaning forward with a fierce determined grin, front wheels lifted off the ground, flames from the exhaust
poses.broken: Full body side view visible, stopped with the hood open and grey smoke puffing out, a flat front tire, sad droopy eyes
